name: OS In-Class Code
postCreateCommand:
/bin/bash -lc '
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update
apt-get install -y build-essential gdb make python3 python3-pip python3-venv file python3-numpy python3-matplotlib python3-scipy
H=$(uname -r)
# Try to install matching kernel headers/modules-extra
if [ ! -e "/lib/modules/$H/build" ]; then
  echo "[info] Installing kernel headers for $H"
  apt-get install -y linux-headers-$H linux-modules-extra-$H || true
fi
# Final check
if [ -e "/lib/modules/$H/build" ]; then
  echo "[ok] Kernel headers present at /lib/modules/$H/build"
else
  echo "[warn] Kernel headers for $H not found. You can build user-space only here. Build kernel modules on a VM with matching headers."
fi
python3 - <<PY
import numpy, matplotlib; print("numpy+matplotlib ok")
PY
'
postStartCommand:
/bin/bash -lc '
H=$(uname -r)
if [ ! -e "/lib/modules/$H/build" ]; then
  echo "[warn] No /lib/modules/$H/build in this session. Trying to install headers..."
  sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y linux-headers-$H linux-modules-extra-$H || true
  if [ -e "/lib/modules/$H/build" ]; then
    echo "[ok] Headers are now available."
  else
    echo "[warn] Still missing headers for $H. You can only build user-space here."
  fi
fi
'
